2026-07-01.title: Shibata City Day Trip + Otakusen Ceremony

2026-07-04.title: Tsukiji + Kabuki-za + Akihabara + Minatomirai + Ado Concert

haneda.name: Haneda Airport (International Terminal)
haneda.description: Arrive in Japan; immigration via Visit Japan Web KIOSK + baggage claim + Suica card exchange

tabinos-hamamatsucho.name: Hotel Tabinos Hamamatsucho
tabinos-hamamatsucho.description: Directly connected to Takeiba Stn (Yurikamome); modern design; best Haneda access (10 min); check-in + rest ／ 🧺 Coin laundry (2 washers/2 dryers, 24h, coin/cashless)

divercity-evening.name: DiverCity Dinner + Flexible Evening
divercity-evening.description: Takeiba→Aomi (10 min)→DiverCity; dinner 18:00–20:00; if energized: Gundam Night Show (20:00) + Aqua Symphony (20:30); if tired: return hotel; DiverCity Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

gundam-night-optional-26.name: Unicorn Gundam Night Show (6/26 Optional)
gundam-night-optional-26.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE (retires Aug 2026)! [Optional] Free; every 30 min from 19:00; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

aqua-symphony-optional-26.name: Tokyo Aqua Symphony (6/26 Optional)
aqua-symphony-optional-26.description: [Optional] Free; Odaiba Marine Park; 15–20 min walk from DiverCity; 10-min fountain show; 20:00 or 21:00 show; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

hotel-breakfast.name: Hotel Tabinos Breakfast
hotel-breakfast.description: Restaurant connected to Takeiba Station; fuel up for the full day

movement-to-ariake.name: Takeiba → Ariake Tennos-no-Mori (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; Takeiba→Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; ~15–20 min

gundam-stamp-1-odaiba-kaihin.name: [Stamp ①] Odaiba-Kaihinkoen Stn (Optional)
gundam-stamp-1-odaiba-kaihin.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); stamp stand inside station; hop off Yurikamome, stamp, re-board next train; only 2–3 min ／ 📍 Google Maps

gundam-stamp-2-waterbus.name: [Stamp ②] Water Bus Terminal (Optional)
gundam-stamp-2-waterbus.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); 5 min walk from Odaiba-Kaihinkoen Stn; Daiba 1-4-1, waterfront pier; stamp and walk back to station ／ 📍 Google Maps

gundam-stamp-3-daiba-station.name: [Stamp ③] Daiba Station (Optional)
gundam-stamp-3-daiba-station.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); stamp stand inside station; hop off Yurikamome, stamp, re-board next train; only 2–3 min ／ 📍 Google Maps

gundam-stamp-4-shiokaze.name: [Stamp ④] Shiokaze Park Observation Deck (Optional)
gundam-stamp-4-shiokaze.description: [Optional] Gundam Stamp Rally 2026 Phase 2 (6/8–7/12); 5–10 min walk from Daiba Stn; stamp at observation deck with sea view; return to station after ／ 📍 Google Maps

small-worlds.name: 🎮 SMALL WORLDS TOKYO
small-worlds.description: [Must-do] World's largest miniature theme park; 3 min from Ariake Tennos-no-Mori Stn; 2.5–3 hrs; or swap with Tokyo Dream Park Doraemon exhibition; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-to-ichiba-mae.name: Ariake → Ichiba-mae (Yurikamome)
movement-to-ichiba-mae.description: Yurikamome Line; very short ~5 min; direct to Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara

toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.name: 🍱 Toyosu Sengyoku Mankara
toyosu-sengyoku-mankara.description: [Must-do] Gourmet food hall at Toyosu Market waterfront complex; seafood bowls, soba, ramen, BBQ; ~1.5 hr dining; Official Site

movement-back-to-ariake.name: Ichiba-mae → Ariake (Yurikamome)
movement-back-to-ariake.description: Yurikamome Line; ~5 min return after lunch

tokyo-dream-park.name: 🎡 Tokyo Dream Park (Doraemon Exhibition · ticketed)
tokyo-dream-park.description: ✅ [Ticket purchased] 3-min walk from Ariake Tennis-no-Mori Stn; first the FREE rooftop plaza (Shohei Ohtani golden statue) ~14:35–15:25 → 🎫 100% Doraemon Exhibition [booked · timed entry 15:30–16:00 · be there by 15:30] ~1.5–2 hrs; Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-to-odaiba.name: Ariake → Aomi (Yurikamome)
movement-to-odaiba.description: Yurikamome Line; ~15 min to DiverCity area

divercity-afternoon.name: 🎮 DiverCity Afternoon (Flexible)
divercity-afternoon.description: Choose freely: ✅ Unko Museum (1–1.5h) ✅ Gundam Base Tokyo 5F (free) ✅ Unicorn Gundam statue photo ✅ Shopping & café; ✅ Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12): collect at DiverCity 2F + 5 other Odaiba spots → instant on-site lottery machine (win = collect prize right there, tourist-friendly!); DiverCity Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

divercity-dinner.name: 🍽️ DiverCity Dinner
divercity-dinner.description: Wide range of restaurants inside the mall; dine as the Gundam transitions from day to night lighting

gundam-night.name: 🌃 Unicorn Gundam Night Show
gundam-night.description: ⚠️ LAST CHANCE — retiring end of August 2026 after nearly 9 years! Free; WALL-G shows every 30 min (19:00–21:30): 19:00 Gundam 45th Anniversary Special Movie · 20:00 UNICORN Special Movie · 21:30 GUNDAM:BEYOND; recommended: 20:00 show; Stamp Rally (6/8–7/12) at DiverCity 2F — collect for chance to win limited RG Gundam; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-to-odaiba-bay.name: Aomi → Odaiba Marine Park (walk)
movement-to-odaiba-bay.description: 15–20 min walk behind DiverCity; scenic Tokyo Bay views along the way

aqua-symphony.name: 💦 Tokyo Aqua Symphony Night Fountain Show
aqua-symphony.description: Free; 3 min from Odaiba Stn; 10 shows/day (11–21:00, no 16:00); recommended 21:00 show; ~10 min; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-return-to-hotel.name: Odaiba → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-to-hotel.description: Yurikamome Line; Odaiba→Takeiba; ~20 min; return to Hotel Tabinos to rest

hotel-breakfast-28.name: Hotel Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-28.description: Restaurant at Takeiba Station; fuel up for a full day in Harajuku + Shinjuku

movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.name: Takeiba → Sangubashi (transit)
movement-hotel-to-sangubashi.description: JR Yamanote Line northbound; ~30 min; heading to Meiji Shrine north entrance

movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.name: Sangubashi → Meiji Shrine North Gate (walk)
movement-sangubashi-to-meiji-north.description: Walk ~30 min through greenery to the north entrance

harajuku-meiji-shrine.name: ⛩️ Meiji Shrine – Forest Walk
harajuku-meiji-shrine.description: Japan's most important Shinto shrine; free; enter north gate, exit east; serene forested path; tranquil contrast to the city; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

harajuku-omotesando.name: 🚶 Omotesando (表參道)
harajuku-omotesando.description: Tokyo's premier upscale shopping street; LV, Gucci, Prada flagships; beautiful architecture; connects directly from Meiji Shrine east exit

movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.name: Omotesando → Takeshita-dori (walk)
movement-omotesando-to-takeshita.description: 10–15 min walk; Omotesando area straight to Takeshita-dori entrance

harajuku-takeshita.name: 🚶 Takeshita-dori (60 min)
harajuku-takeshita.description: World-famous Harajuku youth fashion street; H&M, Forever 21, indie shops, crepes, accessories; lively crowds; grab street food for lunch; Info

movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji.name: Miyashita Park (Shibuya) → Kichijoji (transit)
movement-harajuku-to-kichijoji.description: 5 min walk to Shibuya Stn → Keio Inokashira Line (Express) Shibuya→Kichijoji ~16 min; ~30 min total; heading to Kichijoji Petit Mura

kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro.name: 🏰 Kichijoji Petit Mura + CAPOON + Temari no Oshiro Cat Cafe
kichijoji-petitmura-temarinooshiro.description: Fairy-tale village complex; 2-33-2 Kichijoji Honcho, Musashino; 7-min walk from Kichijoji North Exit; 🍵 CAPOON Matcha: stone-ground matcha drinks & desserts (20 min); 🏰 Temari no Oshiro (Castle Cat Café): castle-themed, ~20 cats, 2-storey; flat weekend entry ¥1,800/person, no time limit; light food menu available; walk-ins welcome; open 10:00–21:00 year-round; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

kichijoji-soratobusakana-lunch.name: ☕ Kuusougai Café — Flying Fish (Afternoon Tea)
kichijoji-soratobusakana-lunch.description: Fantasy-themed café; 2-34-9 Kichijoji Honcho; 7-min walk from Kichijoji South Exit (Park Exit) along Nakamichi-dori; picture-book artist atelier concept; specialty drinks & desserts; ⚠️ No lunch set on weekends — desserts and drinks only on Sundays; open 11:00–19:00 daily; Info article

kichijoji-inokashira-park.name: 🌿 Inokashira Park – Lakeside Stroll [Flexible]
kichijoji-inokashira-park.description: 5-min walk from Flying Fish Café; free entry; lakeside walk + optional swan boat rental; most beautiful natural scenery in Kichijoji; Park Info ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku.name: Kichijoji → Shinjuku West (transit)
movement-kichijoji-to-shinjuku.description: JR Chuo Line (Rapid) Kichijoji→Shinjuku (~22 min); 1-min walk from West Exit to Kagawa Ippuku; ~30 min total

shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku.name: 🍜 Kagawa Ippuku Nishi-Shinjuku (Dinner)
shinjuku-kagawa-ippuku.description: Sanuki udon specialty; 7-9-15 Nishi-Shinjuku, Daikan Plaza Bizness Kiyota Bldg 1F; 1-min walk from Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi Stn D5 exit; Sun/holidays 11:00–21:00 (last order 20:30); Official Site

movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.name: Nishi-Shinjuku → Tochomae (after dinner)
movement-shinjuku-to-tochomae.description: Walk from Kagawa Ippuku to Tokyo Metropolitan Govt Bldg: ~10–12 min (~850m); or Toei Oedo Line Shinjuku-Nishiguchi→Tochomae (1 stop, ~3 min); must arrive by 20:00

tokyo-night-light-projection.name: ✨ Tokyo Night Light – Shinjuku Projection Mapping Show [Must-see]
tokyo-night-light-projection.description: Tokyo Metropolitan Government Building (connected to Tochomae Stn); massive outdoor projection mapping show; every night 20:00–21:00 (confirm before going); free; breathtaking light art; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-return-hotel-28.name: Tochomae → Takeiba (return to hotel)
movement-return-hotel-28.description: Marunouchi Line; ~25 min; return to Hotel Tabinos; rest up for early Shinkansen

hotel-breakfast-29.name: Hotel Breakfast
hotel-breakfast-29.description: Restaurant at Takeiba Station; fuel up before teamLab

movement-hotel-to-teamlab.name: Takeiba → teamLab Borderless (transit)
movement-hotel-to-teamlab.description: Marunouchi Line Takeiba→Akasaka-Mitsuke (~5 min) + 10 min walk to Azabudai Hills

teamlab-29.name: 🎨 teamLab Borderless – Azabudai Hills [Highlight]
teamlab-29.description: [Must-do] Boundary-less immersive digital art; interconnected rooms; light & interactive installations; 3 hrs recommended; must pre-book online; Book Tickets ／ 📍 Google Maps

azabudai-optional-shrines.name: ⛩️ Azabudai Shrines [Optional]
azabudai-optional-shrines.description: [Flexible] After teamLab: if time & energy → quick photo at Reiyukai Shakaden + Nishikubo Hachimangu (15 min); rushed/tired → skip, head to Tokyo Stn ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.name: Azabudai → Echigo-Yuzawa (Shinkansen)
movement-azabudai-to-yuzawa.description: Marunouchi Line Akasaka-Mitsuke→Tokyo Stn (~15 min) + walk to Shinkansen; Joetsu Shinkansen Tokyo→Echigo-Yuzawa 13:00–14:00; pre-book reserved seats (ekinet); enjoy ekiben on board

yuzawa-arrival.name: Echigo-Yuzawa Arrival + Onsen
yuzawa-arrival.description: Explore around the station; hotel hot spring bath; foot bath; cafés; enjoy the resort atmosphere; recharge before dinner

yuzawa-hotel.name: 湯沢グランドホテル (Yuzawa Grand Hotel)
yuzawa-hotel.description: 3 min walk from station; large communal onsen bath + outdoor bath; all-you-can-eat dinner & breakfast (Japanese/Western/Chinese); free luggage storage for 6/30 Kiyotsu trip; Official Site ／ 🧺 Coin laundry (1F, paid, coins)

yuzawa-checkout.name: Hotel Checkout + Luggage Storage
yuzawa-checkout.description: Early checkout; hotel offers free luggage storage; check out and head to Kiyotsu Gorge

movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.name: 🚕 Yuzawa Grand Hotel → Kiyotsu Gorge (Course C charter taxi)
movement-yuzawa-to-kiyotsu.description: ✅ Course C charter taxi (1 sedan, ~2 hrs) — Yuzawa Uonuma Taxi (TEL 025-784-2025); direct to the 1st parking lot (skips the 30-min walk each way), driver waits; ~¥15,000–19,000/car + tunnel tickets; have Yuzawa Grand Hotel front desk book it on 6/29 evening; backup: route bus 13:10 or Snow-Country tour bus

kiyotsu-gorge-morning.name: 🏞️ Kiyotsu Gorge Tunnel ～Mirror Reflection～ [Highlight]
kiyotsu-gorge-morning.description: One of Japan's three great gorges; 750m observation tunnel with the famous water-mirror art at the end (best on sunny days); ~70 min visit (taxi driver waits at the lot); buy 4 tickets on site (Adult ¥1,200×3 + jr-high ¥500 = ¥4,100); bring spare socks for the water mirror; Official / ▶ YouTube ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-kiyotsu-to-yuzawa.name: 🚕 Kiyotsu Gorge → Yuzawa (Course C return)
movement-kiyotsu-to-yuzawa.description: Same charter taxi back to Yuzawa station/hotel; the ~2-hour course covers it; finishing early costs no extra, overtime billed per 30 min

yuzawa-lunch-rest.name: 🍱 Yuzawa Station Lunch + Collect Luggage
yuzawa-lunch-rest.description: Lunch around Yuzawa Station (bakudan onigiri, hegisoba, station cafe) and collect stored luggage; ready for the 13:00 Shinkansen

movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.name: Yuzawa → Niigata (Shinkansen)
movement-yuzawa-to-niigata.description: Joetsu Shinkansen Echigo-Yuzawa→Niigata; ~45 min; arrives far earlier than the bus plan, leaving a relaxed afternoon

niigata-arrival-rest.name: Niigata Station Arrival + Rest
niigata-arrival-rest.description: Store bags at coin lockers or hotel; relax at station mall Popia Bandai or a café; recharge for the afternoon

niigata-hotel-checkin.name: Niigata Hotel Check-in
niigata-hotel-checkin.description: Check in; rest and freshen up before evening festival activities ／ 🧺 Coin laundry (5F; wash ¥400/dry ¥200 per 30min; detergent included; 24h; coins, change at front desk)

niigata-afternoon-activities.name: Niigata City Afternoon
niigata-afternoon-activities.description: Explore Niigata city; local food, shopping around Bandai area or Furumachi Arcade; enjoy the relaxed pace of Niigata

kahara-shrine-first-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Festival Opening Night
kahara-shrine-first-night.description: Kanbara Matsuri (蒲原まつり) opening night; traditional Niigata summer festival dating back 300+ years; stalls, food, performances, mikoshi; free admission; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube ／ 📍 Google Maps

zoushuukan.name: 蔵春閣 (Zoshunkan)
zoushuukan.description: Former Ito Hikohachi villa; elegant Meiji-era architecture; Japanese garden; Info ／ 📍 Google Maps

shimizu-en.name: 清水園 (Shimizu-en Garden)
shimizu-en.description: Traditional Japanese garden formerly attached to the Mizoguchi clan in Shibata; peaceful strolling garden; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

shibata-castle.name: 新発田城 (Shibata Castle)
shibata-castle.description: Japan's 100 Famous Castles #17; unique three-shachi (dolphin-fish) golden turrets; free exterior; restored buildings; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

senbei-kingdom.name: せんべい王国 (Senbei Kingdom)
senbei-kingdom.description: Free admission; draw & paint your own giant rice cracker + flavoring (weekdays, reservation required); fun hands-on experience; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

otakusen-night.name: Kanbara Shrine – Bandai Taiko + Otakusen Ceremony
otakusen-night.description: 18:30 ★ Bandai Taiko (thunderous drum performance) → 19:00 ★ Otakusen (830-year-old Shinto ritual at Kanbara Shrine Kagura-den; free to watch); festival stalls open late; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube ／ 📍 Google Maps

kahara-final.name: Kanbara Festival – Final Day
kahara-final.description: Final day; stalls, Great Daikoku dance offering (15:00); Bandai Taiko already watched on night of 7/1 — depart for Tokyo after Daikoku; free; Official Site / Guide / ▶ YouTube

niigata-haneda-transit.name: Niigata → Tokyo (Shinkansen)
niigata-haneda-transit.description: Joetsu Shinkansen toward Tokyo; ~100 min; arrive early evening with plenty of time to check in and have dinner

ginza-hotel.name: Hotel Vista Tokyo [Tsukiji] – Check-in
ginza-hotel.description: Tsukiji 4-chome, Chuo Ward; ~5 min walk from Tsukiji Stn (Hibiya Line) & Higashi-Ginza Stn; check-in 15:00 / checkout 11:00; walking distance to Tsukiji Outer Market & Kabuki-za; direct Hibiya Line to Akihabara/Asakusa; Official ／ 🧺 Coin laundry (2F service corner; check status from room TV)

movement-niigata-to-kawagoe.name: Niigata → Omiya → Kawagoe (transit)
movement-niigata-to-kawagoe.description: Joetsu Shinkansen Niigata→Omiya (~1h40min) → JR Kawagoe Line Omiya→Kawagoe (~30min); ~2h10min total; rest on the train; 🧳 Kawagoe Stn luggage storage: only ~6–7 large lockers (fill fast) — best to ① pre-book via ecbo cloak (English app, guaranteed spot) or ② manned storage at the tourist info center by the Tobu gate (¥500/bag, 9:00 to ~1hr before close, takes suitcases; collect before leaving ~15:30)

kawagoe-hikawa-shrine.name: 🌸 Kawagoe Hikawa Shrine
kawagoe-hikawa-shrine.description: Kawagoe's beloved matchmaking shrine; 2-11-3 Miyashita-cho; ~20 min walk from Kawagoe Stn East Exit; precincts adorned with wind chimes and enpmusubi (love-tying) balls; free; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

kawagoe-kurazukuri-taisho.name: 🏛️ Kurazukuri Street + Taisho Roman Yume-dori (incl. lunch)
kawagoe-kurazukuri-taisho.description: Kawagoe's main historic street; Important Preservation District; rows of Edo-period clay-walled storehouses (kurazukuri); Taisho Roman Yume-dori runs between Nakacho and Renjakucho with retro Taisho-era shopfronts; street food + lunch included; Kawagoe Tourism Assoc.

kawagoe-tokinokane-starbucks.name: ⏰ Toki no Kane Bell Tower + Starbucks Kawagoe
kawagoe-tokinokane-starbucks.description: 15-7 Saiwai-cho; 400-year-old bell tower; chimes 4 times daily (06:00 · 12:00 · 15:00 · 18:00); adjacent Starbucks occupies a restored kurazukuri storehouse — one of Japan's most photographed Starbucks; terrace seating available; Toki no Kane Info ／ 📍 Google Maps

kawagoe-kashiya-chiikawa.name: 🍬 Kashiya Yokocho + Chiikawa MOGUMOGU Kawagoe
kawagoe-kashiya-chiikawa.description: Moto-machi 2-chome; cobblestone lane of ~20 old-fashioned candy shops dating to the Meiji era; designated 'Fragrant Landscape 100' by Japan's Ministry of Environment; 🐾 Chiikawa Mogumogu Honpo Kawagoe (2-7-9 Moto-machi): Kawagoe-exclusive goods & snacks; weekday = less crowded, no reservation needed (since May 2025); open 09:30–17:30; MOGUMOGU Official

kawagoe-matsuri-kaikan.name: 🎪 Kawagoe Matsuri Kaikan (Festival Museum)
kawagoe-matsuri-kaikan.description: 2-1-10 Moto-machi; UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage — Kawagoe Festival floats (dashi) and float culture displayed up close; open 09:30–18:30 (Apr–Sep); closed Tuesdays (7/2 is Thursday ✅); Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-kawagoe-to-higashiginza.name: Kawagoe → Hotel Vista Tokyo [Tsukiji] (transit)
movement-kawagoe-to-higashiginza.description: Tobu Tojo Line Express Kawagoe→Ikebukuro (~30 min) → Tokyo Metro Yurakucho Line Ikebukuro→Shintomicho (~25 min) → 5 min walk; ~1h10min total

tsukiji-market.name: Tsukiji Outer Market (築地場外市場)
tsukiji-market.description: Breakfast recommended; 5 min walk; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; morning = freshest produce and best atmosphere; Official Site

tsukiji-honganji.name: Tsukiji Honganji Temple
tsukiji-honganji.description: 10 min walk; free; striking Indian-style Buddhist architecture; beautiful in morning light ／ 📍 Google Maps

kabuki-za.name: Kabuki-za – Curtain-View Seat (幕見席)
kabuki-za.description: July Grand Kabuki (7/2–7/26); Matinée 11:00; Recommended 幕見: Suehirogari (1st act, short celebratory dance); 4F single-act seating; English audio guide ¥1,000/unit; no photography during performance; photos allowed during intermission; Curtain-View Tickets · July Programme ／ 📍 Google Maps

senso-ji.name: Senso-ji Temple, Kaminarimon & Nakamise
senso-ji.description: Tokyo's most visited temple; free; iconic Kaminarimon thunder gate; Nakamise shopping street; morning = fewer crowds; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

higashi-hongan-ji.name: Higashi Hongan-ji (Asakusa)
higashi-hongan-ji.description: Free; West Asakusa 1-5-5; 5 min walk from Senso-ji; peaceful alternative temple worth a quick visit; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

samurai-ninja.name: Samurai Ninja Museum Asakusa
samurai-ninja.description: English-guided tour; armour wearing + shuriken throwing; ~60 min; 3 min walk from Higashi Hongan-ji; pre-book online; Book Online

kappabashi-tanabata.name: 🎋 Kappabashi – Shitamachi Tanabata Festival
kappabashi-tanabata.description: Bamboo Tanabata decorations, food stalls; 1.2km from Showa-dori to Kokusai-dori; 5 min from Samurai Ninja Museum; free strolling; Asakusa Tourism / Official Site / ▶ YouTube ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-asakusa-to-hotel.name: Asakusa → Hotel (Higashi-Ginza) [transit]
movement-asakusa-to-hotel.description: Hibiya Line Asakusa→Higashi-Ginza; ~20 min; early return to prep for next day

hotel-rest-evening-3.name: Hotel Rest + Dinner + Early Sleep
hotel-rest-evening-3.description: Return to Via Inn Higashi-Ginza; rest, pack bags; dinner 17:30–19:00; early sleep to be fresh for Akihabara day

tsukiji-market-morning.name: Tsukiji Market (Quick Breakfast)
tsukiji-market-morning.description: Quick breakfast before checkout; fresh seafood, tamagoyaki, sushi; open from 06:00; Official Site

hotel-checkout-4.name: Hotel Vista Tokyo [Tsukiji] – Checkout + Luggage Storage
hotel-checkout-4.description: Check out (11:00); leave luggage with hotel storage (collect before 17:00); complete by 11:00; ⚠️ confirm at the desk that luggage can be held until ~17:00 (collect in the evening before heading to Shin-Yokohama)

movement-akiba-to-minato.name: Nihonbashi → Tsukiji (luggage) → Minatomirai
movement-akiba-to-minato.description: Nihonbashi→Tsukiji (Asakusa/Hibiya Line ~15 min) to collect stored luggage → Tsukiji→Yokohama/Minatomirai (~45–50 min); ~70–80 min total

minato-light-meal-rest.name: Minatomirai – Light Meal & Rest
minato-light-meal-rest.description: Brief rest after arriving in Minatomirai; light snack or meal to recharge

akarenga.name: 赤レンガ倉庫 (Red Brick Warehouse) + Harbour Walk
akarenga.description: Free; photogenic Meiji-era red brick warehouses; Yokohama harbour scenery; beautiful in late afternoon light; Official Site

movement-minato-to-shinyoko.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (transit)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~20 min; check in at Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama on arrival

shinyoko-hotel.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Check-in
shinyoko-hotel.description: Natural hot spring bath; free breakfast; 10–12 min walk to Nissan Stadium; check in, rest, freshen up ／ 🧺 Coin laundry (2F by front desk, 24h, free detergent, ~¥100/30min wash & dry, 2 each)

movement-hotel-to-stadium.name: Hotel → Nissan Stadium (walk)
movement-hotel-to-stadium.description: 10–12 min walk; arrive early to queue for merchandise; bring towel, water, sunscreen (outdoor venue)

ado-1.name: Ado Concert – Night 1 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-1.description: Nissan Stadium (~72,000 capacity); large outdoor concert; tickets confirmed; wait 30–45 min after show before leaving (crowd management) ／ 📍 Google Maps

yamashita-park.name: 山下公園 (Yamashita Park)
yamashita-park.description: Free; panoramic Yokohama Harbour views; seaside promenade; stroll and take photos ／ 📍 Google Maps

osaka-daisan-bashi.name: 大さん橋 (Osanbashi – Yokohama International Pier)
osaka-daisan-bashi.description: Free; Yokohama International Cruise Terminal; dramatic curved wooden rooftop terrace with sweeping harbour views; one of Yokohama's most beautiful spots ／ 📍 Google Maps

motomachi.name: 元町ショッピングストリート (Motomachi)
motomachi.description: Yokohama's historic upscale shopping street; stylish boutiques, cafés, pastry shops; foreign settlement atmosphere

cup-noodles.name: カップヌードルミュージアム (Cup Noodles Museum)
cup-noodles.description: Admission needs no reservation (buy on site); 🍜 My Cup Noodle Factory (design your own cup): online time-slot reservation required (¥500/cup, 13 slots 10:00–16:30); Chicken Ramen Factory (¥1,200/¥600) needs reservation by 18:00 the day before and ~90 min, skipped as 7/5 has only 1h; Reserve / Official / 📍 Google Maps
cup-noodles.price: Admission Adult ¥500 · HS & under free; My Cup Noodle ¥500/cup

air-cabin.name: YOKOHAMA AIR CABIN
air-cabin.description: Cable car ride over the canal; Unga Park Stn → Sakuragi-cho Stn; ~5 min scenic aerial ride ／ 📍 Google Maps

bandai-namco-cross-store.name: 🎮 Bandai Namco Cross Store Yokohama
bandai-namco-cross-store.description: Yokohama World Porters 2F; 1 min from Unga Park Stn; 20+ official shops (Gundam, JoJo, etc.); Gashapon corner; amusement area; free entry; Official Site ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.name: Minatomirai → Shin-Yokohama (return)
movement-minato-to-shinyoko-2.description: Minatomirai Line→Yokohama Line; ~25 min; return to hotel; rest up for Night 2 concert

ado-2.name: Ado Concert – Night 2 (Nissan Stadium)
ado-2.description: Nissan Stadium; tickets confirmed; wait after show; prepare for tomorrow's checkout ／ 📍 Google Maps

shinyoko-checkout.name: Super Hotel Shin-Yokohama – Early Checkout
shinyoko-checkout.description: Early checkout; pack luggage; heading to Kawasaki Daishi

haneda-luggage.name: Haneda Airport – Luggage Storage
haneda-luggage.description: Storage at any terminal; collect before departure

kawasaki-daishi.name: 川崎大師 Kawasaki Daishi (Heiken-ji Temple)
kawasaki-daishi.description: Founded 1128; one of Japan's top 3 most-visited temples; worship + Nakamise-dori shopping approach; traditional sweets and crafts; Info ／ 📍 Google Maps

nakamise-dori.name: 仲見世通り (Nakamise Shopping Street)
nakamise-dori.description: Temple approach shopping street; traditional crafts, souvenirs, food; last Japan shopping before departure

kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.name: 📸 Kawasaki Daishi – Yakuyoke-mon Gate (大山門)
kawasaki-yakuyoke-mon.description: Iconic vermillion main gate at the Nakamise-dori entrance; symbol of Kawasaki Daishi; quick photo stop only; free ／ 📍 Google Maps

haneda-return.name: Haneda Airport – International Departure
haneda-return.description: Collect luggage + duty-free shopping + check-in + immigration; arrive at airport by 13:30

movement-takeshita-to-miyashita-28.name: Takeshita-dori → Miyashita Park
movement-takeshita-to-miyashita-28.description: ~12 min walk south via Cat Street / Meiji-dori to Shibuya Miyashita Park (RAYARD MIYASHITA PARK)

miyashita-park-adidas-28.name: 🦁 Miyashita Park – adidas PLAY FREE PARK (Ado Statue + adiFOTO)
miyashita-park-adidas-28.description: [Final day 6/28!] adidas football-themed pop-up; 🗽 life-sized Ado statue in the adidas Japan national football team kit; 📸 adiFOTO: Ado collaboration photo booth (purikura) with original designs; venue: Miyashita Park multi-purpose sports facility (sand court); Sun 11:00–20:00; free; RAYARD Miyashita Park has the "Shibuya Yokocho" food street for lunch; Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-hotel-to-akihabara-702.name: Tsukiji → Akihabara
movement-hotel-to-akihabara-702.description: Tsukiji→Akihabara, Hibiya Line direct ~10 min; arrive by 17:50 for the owl cafe

akiba-fukurou-702.name: 🦉 Akiba Fukurou Owl Cafe (Private Session)
akiba-fukurou-702.description: ✅ Booked: Private Session (7/2 18:00–19:00, 4 people); exclusive owl experience (hold owls + pro photographer); ⚠️ arrive by 17:50 (door locks once it starts); cash only; ⚠️ no food/drink menu — owl experience only; 67 Kanda Neribeicho, Chiyoda; 2 min from Akihabara Stn Central Gate; Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

akihabara-dinner-702.name: 🍽️ Akihabara Dinner
akihabara-dinner-702.description: After the owl experience; plenty of Akihabara restaurants (ramen, set meals, conveyor sushi, themed cafes)

movement-akihabara-to-hotel-702.name: Akihabara → Hotel Vista Tokyo [Tsukiji] (return)
movement-akihabara-to-hotel-702.description: Akihabara→Tsukiji, Hibiya Line direct ~10 min; return to hotel

movement-hotel-to-hamarikyu-704.name: Tsukiji → Hamarikyu Gardens
movement-hotel-to-hamarikyu-704.description: Tsukiji → Shiodome/Tsukiji-Shijo area (walk or Oedo Line) ~15 min; short walk to garden entrance

hamarikyu-garden-704.name: 🌳 Hamarikyu Gardens
hamarikyu-garden-704.description: Edo-period daimyo garden; tidal pond, 300-year-old pine, seasonal flowers; Nakajima Tea House on the pond serves matcha + wagashi (extra); a calm green oasis for a relaxed stroll — conserve energy for tonight; 09:00–17:00 (last entry 16:30); Adult ¥300, 65+ ¥150, junior-high & under free; Official ／ 📍 Google Maps

movement-hamarikyu-to-nihonbashi-704.name: Hamarikyu → Nihonbashi
movement-hamarikyu-to-nihonbashi-704.description: Hamarikyu → Shimbashi → Ginza Line Shimbashi→Nihonbashi ~5 min; ~25 min total

nihonbashi-704.name: 🏛️ Nihonbashi (Mitsukoshi, COREDO Muromachi, Fukutoku Shrine) + Lunch
nihonbashi-704.description: Historic Edo-era commercial district; Nihonbashi Mitsukoshi flagship (Important Cultural Property, Tennyo statue); COREDO Muromachi (dining & specialty shops); Fukutoku Shrine; Nihonbashi bridge (road origin marker); plenty of lunch options at COREDO Muromachi

round1-tsunashima.name: 🎮 Round1 Yokohama Tsunashima [Optional · Games]
round1-tsunashima.description: Family entertainment complex (has an 18+ pachislot corner — just skip it); arcade option during the Shin-Yokohama stay; Shin-Yokohama→(Shin-Yokohama Line)Shin-Tsunashima→~10 min walk; full rhythm-game lineup: 1F maimai DX, CHUNITHM×2, ONGEKI×2, Taiko no Tatsujin; 4F beatmania IIDX, pop'n, DDR×2, jubeat, SOUND VOLTEX×3; also 36-lane bowling, karaoke, darts, billiards; ⚠️ under-16 need a guardian after 18:00 (OK with family); pay per play; Store / Full machine list (official) / 📍 Google Maps

shirohige-kichijoji-28.name: 🐉 Shirohige Cream Puff Factory – Kichijoji (Totoro Cream Puffs)
shirohige-kichijoji-28.description: Officially Ghibli-licensed Totoro-themed sweets shop; signature 🐉 Totoro cream puffs, Catbus sandwich, Totoro cookie boxes; ⚠️ takeaway only (no dine-in); 11:00–17:00, closed Tue (6/28 Sun OK); ~5–7 min walk from Kichijoji South Exit toward Inokashira Park; grab them to enjoy by the pond; a Totoro touch to make up for the cancelled Ghibli Museum; ⚠️ sells out fast (sometimes by 14:00), worse on Sundays → phone-reserve at 0422-26-6550 (specify ~16:30 pickup, flavors & qty); Official / 📍 Google Maps
shirohige-kichijoji-28.price: Totoro cream puff ~¥600+ each (flavors: custard, chocolate + 2 seasonal)

denbouin-dori.name: 🏮 Denbouin-dori [Last chance · removed end of July 2026]
denbouin-dori.description: Retro Edo-style shopping street beside Senso-ji/Nakamise (~200m, links Nakamise to Rokku); shopfronts & signs styled after the Edo townscape, with a Nezumi-Kozo figure on a roof; ⚠️ 32 shops must vacate by 31 July 2026 after a long-running illegal road-occupation lawsuit settlement → your 7/3 visit is the last chance to see it; just step in while touring Senso-ji/Nakamise; free; 📍 Google Maps

ponshukan-yuzawa.name: 🥤 Ponshukan Echigo-Yuzawa (Koji café, bomb onigiri, sake bath)
ponshukan-yuzawa.description:
Inside Echigo-Yuzawa Station (CoCoLo Yuzawa); Niigata rice & fermentation hall — all the below are alcohol-free & kid-friendly:
🥤 Koji Latte café: koji/amazake latte, soft serve, floats (non-alcoholic, all ages) + snow-room coffee ⭐ great for kids
🍙 Bomb Onigiri: giant hand-rolled Minamiuonuma Koshihikari rice balls
♨️ Sake Bath: hot spring soak (non-alcoholic; adult ¥950 / child ¥400 / under-5 free)
Right inside the station — easy on arrival/departure ／ 📍 Google Maps
ponshukan-yuzawa.price: Koji latte/soft serve a few hundred yen; bomb onigiri a few hundred yen; sake bath adult ¥950/child ¥400

yokai-immersive-26.name: 👹 YOKAI Immersive Digital Exhibition [Optional · ends 6/28]
yokai-immersive-26.description: World-first yokai-themed immersive digital art exhibition (3DCG, projection mapping, holograms + sculptures bringing Edo/Meiji yokai scrolls to life); Warehouse TERRADA G1, Tennozu (5-min walk from Tennozu Isle Stn, on the Haneda Monorail line, ~1 stop from the Hamamatsucho hotel); ✅ mostly non-verbal/visual, captions in JP+English → fine for non-Japanese speakers; ⚠️ ends 6/28 → only 6/26–6/28 possible, arrival evening (6/26) is the realistic window; 9:30–20:00 (last entry 19:30); Official ／ 📍 Google Maps
